Name: Automatic felling
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Automatic Felling[/b]

Adds two machines that let you [b]passively collect wood[/b] from [b]any tree[/b], similar to how tappers work.

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]
• [b]Wood Collector[/b] – The recipe unlocks at [b]Foraging level 8[/b].
 Place it on any tree to generate [b]Wood[/b] over time.

• [b]Hardwood Collector[/b] – The recipe unlocks at [b]Foraging level 10[/b].
 Place it on any tree to generate [b]Hardwood[/b] over time.

Both machines can be placed on any tree — [b]oak, maple, pine, or mahogany[/b] — and will automatically produce wood depending on the collector type.
They are used [b]just like tappers[/b]: simply place them on the tree and let them work!

[b][u]Update 1.0.5[/u][/b]
• Added [b]configuration options[/b] to customize the [b]daily production amount[/b] of [b]Wood and Hardwood[/b].
• In [b]Balanced Mode[/b], you can now also configure the [b]chance to obtain Hardwood instead of Wood[/b].

[b][u]Old updates[/u][/b]
• Now works on [b]fruit trees[/b] as well!
• Added [b]appearance options[/b]: you can switch between [b]Classic[/b] and [b]Magical[/b] modes.
 In [b]Magical Mode[/b], small [b]fairies appear around the trees[/b], gathering wood in a whimsical way.
• Added a new [b]Balanced Mode[/b] option:
 Instead of using both collectors, this mode only adds the [b]Wood Collector[/b].
 It mainly produces [b]Wood[/b], but has a [b]small chance to produce Hardwood[/b].
 The recipe unlocks at [b]Foraging level 9[/b].

[b][u]Future Plans[/u][/b]
• Config options for [b]production time[/b].
• Config options for [b]crafting material requirements[/b].
